scope: Versioned bounded workflow inventory; not exhaustive 32-area coverage or runtime/hardware readiness

workflows.title: Lazy model registration

inputs.description: Identifier, callable constructor, group and optional local help path

outputs.description: Native constructor object selected explicitly

limits: Factories execute only at explicit construction; registration is process-local; names cannot replace built-ins

workflows.title: Offline module/model documentation

inputs.description: Known topic identifier

outputs.description: Bundled Markdown string or sorted topic list

limits: No backend import, remote fetch or documentation server

workflows.title: Independent dense tensors and autograd

inputs.description: Finite built-in numbers, nonempty rectangular lists, optional explicit shape; native model and targets for fit

outputs.description: Rank0–8 float64 CPU Tensor, matching-shape leaf gradients; fit mapping with model/history/steps

limits: 100,000 elements per tensor; no zero-size dimensions or GPU operators; legacy scalar/vector normalization retained

workflows.title: Independent COO/CSR algebra

inputs.description: Explicit rank2 coordinates/row pointers, finite values and positive logical shape

outputs.description: Sparse container or bounded dense result; gradients reach supplied values/dense operands

limits: 100,000 stored entries/dense result; no implicit densification or sparse×sparse

workflows.title: Explicit compiled matmul and gradients

inputs.description: Fresh output directory, trusted ABI-matching kernel, Tensor.matmul(kernel=...)

outputs.description: Locally built kernel or float64 matmul result with VJPs

limits: Only explicit opt-in; Linux/CPython target; no automatic compilation or general operator acceleration

workflows.title: Classical fit/predict/evaluate/persistence

inputs.description: Estimator, row-aligned features/targets, optional nonnegative weights and held-out validation

outputs.description: ClassicalResult with model/run/metrics/task/warnings/status; prediction arrays or versioned trusted bundle

limits: Backend estimator parameters remain explicit; trust required for executable artifact loading

workflows.title: Pipelines, leakage-safe CV and search

inputs.description: Unfitted pipeline, features/targets, explicit split/CV/search parameters and fit budgets

outputs.description: Split/CV/search results preserving held-out boundaries

limits: Declared group/temporal/nested contracts; adaptive distributed search is separately scoped

workflows.title: Unsupervised catalog workflows

inputs.description: Selected estimator and finite compatible feature representation

outputs.description: Fitted ClassicalResult, labels/projections or task metrics

limits: Supported paths depend on estimator predict/transform methods; catalog aliases are not independent implementations

workflows.title: Fixed-horizon forecasting

inputs.description: Ordered univariate series, lags/horizon and fixed-cadence calendar options

outputs.description: Scoped forecaster and rolling-origin reports

limits: Not a general ARIMA, multivariate, irregular or hierarchical suite

workflows.title: Query-group ranking

inputs.description: Features, relevance grades and explicit query groups

outputs.description: Ranker and per-query ranking metrics

limits: No unbiased click-feedback/causal-ranking guarantee

workflows.title: Sparse recommendation baseline

inputs.description: User/item interactions with explicit candidate/co-occurrence budgets

outputs.description: Item-cosine/popularity recommendations and held-out ranking metrics

limits: No neural/ALS or vector-database claim

workflows.title: Right-censored survival integration

inputs.description: Features, durations and event indicators

outputs.description: Cox/Kaplan–Meier outputs and scoped concordance

limits: No competing risks, time-varying or clinical validity claim

workflows.title: Bounded immutable JSONL data

inputs.description: JSON-compatible records and explicit byte/record budgets

outputs.description: Immutable JSONL snapshot and manifest; fresh Records on load

limits: Local data only; no Arrow dtype or external broker transaction claim

workflows.title: Torch model training and evaluation

inputs.description: Torch module and dataset/loader of inputs/targets or declared custom task batches

outputs.description: TrainingResult(model/run/history/checkpoint/status); task metrics/predictions

limits: Exact resume only for declared loader/config/epoch contracts; generic artifact save remains classical-specific

workflows.title: CPU DDP/FSDP training and shards

inputs.description: CPU module, tensors and explicit fixed-world distributed options

outputs.description: Native exported model plus checkpoint/shard diagnostics

limits: Two-rank CPU contracts; exact trusted shard resume has version/world/data restrictions; no multi-host/GPU acceptance

workflows.title: Native environment-training integrations

inputs.description: Supported algorithm and compatible environment; explicit timesteps/evaluation environment

outputs.description: RLTrainingResult(model/run/requested_steps/actual_steps/status); trusted policy bundles

limits: Simulator continuation limited to declared CPU DQN/PPO/A2C protocol environments

workflows.title: Offline imitation and discrete CQL

inputs.description: Bounded explicit transition/action arrays, masks and matching config

outputs.description: OfflineResult with model/history/checkpoint/status

limits: Discrete CQL is not continuous CQL/IQL; no arbitrary OOD quality guarantee

workflows.title: Masked parallel collection and centralized offline AWR

inputs.description: Explicit parallel environment/policies or aligned agent datasets and team returns

outputs.description: Per-agent arrays or CentralizedResult(policies/critic/history/checkpoint/status)

limits: Fixed-cohort offline AWR is not online MAPPO; truncation requires authoritative terminal metadata

workflows.title: Pinned pretrained CPU inference and LoRA

inputs.description: Explicit pinned local safetensors snapshot/tokenizer; token windows and adapter config

outputs.description: Native model/tokenizer, generated text, NLL reports and adapter artifacts

limits: Declared134.5M SmolLM2 target; no download at install/import; no billion/GPU/all-architecture acceptance

workflows.title: CPU quantization and INT8 weight storage

inputs.description: Compatible CPU model; explicit method, exclusions and numerical tolerance

outputs.description: Owned quantized model preserving caller state

limits: Weight-only mode uses FP32 compute; dynamic activation INT8 failed the declared SmolLM2 tolerance; no automatic speedup

workflows.title: Owned process-tree execution

inputs.description: Explicit trusted worker target, data and resource/deadline limits

outputs.description: Result or typed execution error with durable status/recovery record

limits: Trusted-code ownership, not hostile-code sandbox; Windows requires creation-time Job Object support

workflows.title: Linux kernel memory containment

inputs.description: Explicit delegated cgroup-v2 subtree and job limits

outputs.description: Kernel-contained job plus memory/OOM evidence

limits: Delegation required; no global controller mutation or hard GPU quota claim

workflows.title: Managed single-tenant TLS inference reference

inputs.description: Trusted CPU model, explicit credentials/TLS and bounded request budgets

outputs.description: Isolated inference, authenticated gateway/client and aggregate metrics

limits: Gateway/client themselves use stdlib only; reference is not audited public/multi-tenant ingress

workflows.title: Real CUDA AMP acceptance

inputs.description: Suitable explicitly provisioned target

outputs.description: Acceptance report only after real target execution

limits: Actual CUDA FP16/BF16/overflow/resume acceptance not run here

workflows.title: Real GPU distributed/sharded acceptance

inputs.description: Suitable explicitly provisioned target

outputs.description: Acceptance report only after real target execution

limits: Requires two supported GPUs/NCCL; CPU passes do not certify this target

workflows.title: Independent GPU operators and hard VRAM containment

inputs.description: Suitable explicitly provisioned target

outputs.description: Acceptance report only after real target execution

limits: Device-specific kernels/aggregate VRAM quotas are not implemented/validated

workflows.title: Physical older-PC acceptance

inputs.description: Suitable explicitly provisioned target

outputs.description: Acceptance report only after real target execution

limits: Constrained modern-host benchmarks do not certify old ISA/cache/storage

workflows.title: Public or multi-tenant deployment acceptance

inputs.description: Suitable explicitly provisioned target

outputs.description: Acceptance report only after real target execution

limits: Actual deployment host, authorization/revocation and workload SLO acceptance remain open

workflows.title: Bounded local image classification and checkpoint inference

inputs.description: Local root/class/file images; shared class order; EXIF/RGB/white-alpha/bilinear/CHW float32 preprocessing with byte/pixel/inventory limits.

outputs.description: Lazy map dataset, neural TrainingResult, held-out loss/accuracy, JSON preprocessing/label manifest, checkpoint and streamed labels/probabilities.

limits: 1000 training/300 held-out real digits; 89.3% accuracy, not natural-image accuracy.
Default 16MiB encoded/4M source pixels per image; no decoded cache.
Detection/segmentation/OCR/tracking, pretrained backbones, export and serving acceptance are open.

workflows.title: Backend-neutral result metadata and neural result dispatch

inputs.description: Supported native, classical, neural, online/offline/centralized RL training outcomes; numerical backends only to construct those outcomes.

outputs.description: Schema-1 ResultInfo metadata (family, status, counts, paths, steps), without weights; prediction/evaluation also accept neural TrainingResult.

limits: Structural protocols do not validate backend types or tensor shapes.
Family-specific data, callbacks, cancellation and persistence remain explicit; alpha contract.

workflows.title: Cited lexical retrieval and explicit-generator RAG

inputs.description: Unicode document text with source IDs, bounded chunking, questions and optional explicit generator callback.

outputs.description: Ranked provenance/citations, extractive or callback answers, abstention, retrieval metrics and immutable index reload.

limits: BM25 only; no learned embeddings or general semantic answer-fidelity acceptance.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.

workflows.title: Approved tool plans, owned deadlines and durable prefix recovery

inputs.description: Ordered tool plan, existing Tool schemas, explicit allowed names/versions and journal path.

outputs.description: Committed plain-JSON trace, bounded owned calls, cancellation/deadlines, explicit safe-prefix resume and shortest paths.

limits: Trusted importable tools; ambiguous failed/running external actions require reconciliation; no exactly-once or autonomous-agent quality claim.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.

workflows.title: Conjugate posteriors and cross-fitted binary-treatment AIPW

inputs.description: Binary outcomes for Beta; Gaussian linear data; or bounded features/binary treatment/continuous outcome with identification assumptions.

outputs.description: Posterior predictive statistics and JSON reload, or causal ATE/asymptotic interval with explicit assumptions and fold assignment.

limits: No general probabilistic programming, causal discovery or identification of unmeasured confounding; overlap violations fail.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.

workflows.title: Active/semi/self-supervised, prototype and bounded replay workflows

inputs.description: Explicit labeled/unlabeled pools, paired views, support/query embeddings or bounded JSON stream records.

outputs.description: Budgeted query indices, fitted native self-training model, differentiable NT-Xent, few-shot predictions and exact replay continuation.

limits: No generic quality-improvement, large meta-learning or continual forgetting claim; negative active-learning result is retained.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.

workflows.title: PCM WAV and audio classification frontend

inputs.description: Bounded local uncompressed integer PCM WAV, explicit sample rate/channel/duration and FFT configuration.

outputs.description: Channel-first waveform, explicit linear resampling, aligned segments and streaming-summary spectral features for classifiers.

limits: No ASR/TTS, compressed-audio codec or bandlimited-resampling claim; recorded-audio decoding and synthetic-tone classification are separate.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.

workflows.title: Timed visual clips, owned video decoding and fixed-schema fusion
prerequisites: Explicit FFmpeg/ffprobe installation for load_video only

inputs.description: Local GIF/TIFF or explicit FFmpeg video; declared frames/timelines/audio coverage and modality feature dimensions.

outputs.description: Bounded RGB clips/timestamps, aligned audio segments and fused fixed-order vectors/presence masks with checkpointed classifier examples.

limits: FFmpeg/ffprobe are explicit external prerequisites for MP4/WebM. Constant-rate sampling does not preserve original variable-frame timestamps; no semantic video-language model claim.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.

workflows.title: Homogeneous GCN node and graph classification

inputs.description: Finite float32/64 homogeneous node features, int64 endpoints, caller-owned labels and explicit train/test masks.

outputs.description: Sparse normalized propagation, disjoint batches, differentiable node/graph logits, pooled features, JSON graphs and neural checkpoints.

limits: Undirected unweighted homogeneous graphs only; real karate result is transductive, not a citation-network/link-prediction or heterogeneous-graph claim.
Current v1 scope and remaining requirements are explicit in SEVEN_WORKFLOWS.md.
